description.value: Darcy's Pub is a downtown Victoria pub on Wharf Street serving house-made west coast pub fare alongside a curated selection of local BC beers and original cocktails. The venue hosts regular live music events and features both indoor and outdoor seating. It is an adults-only (19+) licensed establishment.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (6 spaces) at 82m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m; stands (6 spaces) at 94m; stands (2 spaces) at 94m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website at darcyspub.ca confirms the pub at 1127 Wharf Street, Victoria, and provides phone (250) 380-1322 — absent from OSM. The website explicitly states 'gluten friendly and vegan options,' supporting that amenity. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, takeout, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number listed; phone (250) 380-1322 sourced from website only.
Events calendar page shows events only from 2020 (COVID era), suggesting that page has not been updated; however, the main site content appears current.
Establishment is 19+ only (NO MINORS), which may be relevant for groups cycling with minors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub in downtown Victoria with active website and confirmed address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and drink.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'House made west coast pub fare with gluten friendly and vegan options.'

wow_evidence: house-made west coast pub fare … curated selection of local BC beers … regular live music
